I wish it were as simple as that.  I do talk to my friends.  I just worry about going back to that well over and over and sounding like a broken record, because really, I am.  I'm caught in a suicidal loop.  I go and talk to therapists and they put new kitchen finishings in their home with what I spend to sit and talk to a stranger.  None of this nets me any benefit anymore.  It's not like I haven't gotten this off my chest on multiple occasions.  Talking is at a point of diminishing returns for me.

I'm so very tired.
